sections.heading: Fertilizer Licence Registration in India – Everything You Need to Know Before Starting Your Agri Business
paragraphs: Have you been dreaming about owning your own fertilizer shop, providing the farmers with the nutrients their crops require, and being a renowned name in your community?
Oh, you, before you can sell not a bag of urea or DAP, you must possess one golden ticket, and that is, fertilizer licence registration in India.

There is no need to panic over the fact that the term licence may already evoke the idea of governmental documents and a long line. In this blog, I am going to take you through the process in simple straightforward language- just like a friendly guide on the other side of the table. You will be in the know of what to do, and may even get excited about it!
Imagine it in this way, to drive a car you must have a driving licence. On the same note, you would require a fertilizer licence in case you would like to sell, store or produce fertilizers.
You may be fined or even closed down.
Farmers may not trust you.
Large suppliers will not form an alliance with you.
You are a legal business.
You have the privilege to operate your agriculture fertilizer shop licence.
Why, farmers will believe you to be a real, dependable source.
Shortly: your licence is not a piece of paper only--it is your ticket to credibility in the farming world.
Almost every person who concerns himself with fertilizers at all:
Manufacturers - If you are making fertilizers.
Wholesalers/Distributors -When you are supplying to shops or dealers.
Retail Shop Owners - Yes, your licence of fertilizer shop of agriculture falls under this.
